label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.5…: Every GENUS_1 has at least one differentia dividing it
locator: I q.3 a.5 co., second proof: omne enim genus habet differentias quae sunt extra essentiam generis
interpretation: Read only the first half: every genus has differentiae, weakened to at least one. The second half (they are outside the essence of the genus) is the claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A5-DIFFERENTIAE-OUTSIDE-GENUS-A.
